info.title: Hash API
info.summary: Accept crypto payments: invoices, decisions, balances and webhooks.
info.description:
The Hash merchant API. Call it from your server with a secret API key; never from a browser or an app.

## Authentication

Send a secret key as a bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer hash_live_sk_...`. A key belongs to one mode and only ever sees that mode's data: `hash_live_sk_` keys are **live** (real money, mainnets), `hash_sandbox_sk_` keys are **sandbox** (test networks). After the prefix a key has exactly 40 letters and digits. Create keys in the dashboard (Developers, API keys); the secret is shown once.

Each operation needs one scope, named in its description and in `x-hash-scope`: `invoices:read`, `invoices:write`, `invoices:decide`, `funds:review`, `balances:read` or `webhooks:write`. No scope implies another. A suspended company's keys may still read, but every write is `403 tenant_suspended`.

## Idempotency

Every `POST` and `PATCH` needs an `Idempotency-Key` header (1 to 255 bytes, not blank; a UUID is a good choice). A retry with the same key, method, path and body answers with the first answer (same status and body) and the header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, and never repeats the work. Keys are per API key and mode, and are kept for 24 hours. Reusing a key for a different request is `422 idempotency_key_reused`. While the first request is still running a retry waits up to 5 seconds for its answer, then answers `409 idempotency_key_in_progress`. Answers with status 408, 409, 423, 425, 429 or 5xx are not kept: a retry made after one runs the request again, and a retry that was waiting when one came answers `409 idempotency_key_in_progress` (retry again). A request that never answered frees its key after 60 seconds. An answer that showed a secret (a new webhook endpoint's `secret`) is replayed as `409 secret_shown_once`, without the secret.

## Errors

Errors are JSON: `{"error": "<code>"}`, sometimes with a `message` and fields specific to the code (see `Error` and `ErrorCode`). A method a path does not support answers `405 method_not_allowed` with an `Allow` header. Validation failures (`422`) are different: `{"message": "...", "errors": {"<field>": ["..."]}}` (see `ValidationError`). Each operation lists exactly the codes it can return.

## Rate limits

Each API key may make 120 requests a minute across every operation. Answers past authentication carry `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`. Past the limit the answer is `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` and `retryAfter` (seconds) in the body. The public `GET /meta/webhook-ips` allows 120 requests a minute per client IP.

## Formats

Money is never a JSON number. US dollar amounts are strings with 2 decimals (`"48.50"`). Coin amounts are strings with the coin's full precision, trailing zeros included (`"0.01250000"` BTC). Times are UTC, ISO 8601 with a `Z` (`2026-11-20T10:04:12Z`). Fields may be added to any object at any time: parse by name and ignore what you do not know.

## Pagination

The list operations (`GET /invoices`, `GET /webhook-endpoints`, `GET /webhook-deliveries`) answer `{"object": "list", "data": [...], "has_more": true, "next_cursor": "..."}`, newest first (by creation time, then id). `limit` sets the page size (1 to 100, default 20). For the next page send `next_cursor` back as `cursor`, with the same filters; it is `null` on the last page. Cursors are opaque and stable: objects created while you page never shift a page. A cursor a list did not hand out is `422 invalid_cursor`. `created[gte]` and `created[lte]` (both inclusive, ISO 8601) narrow a list to a time range.

## Webhooks

Events are sent as signed `POST` requests to your endpoints (see the `webhooks` section). Each carries `Hash-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256>`, `Hash-Timestamp` and `Hash-Delivery-Id` (the `whd_` id to resend it with). To verify: compute HMAC-SHA256 of `"<t>.<raw body>"` with your endpoint's secret, accept the request when it equals any `v1` (constant-time comparison), and reject it when `t` is more than 5 minutes from your clock. For 24 hours after a secret rotation each request carries a second `v1`, signed with the previous secret. The event `id` is the same on every retry and resend: deduplicate on it.

get.description:
Returns the key's invoices, newest first, one page at a time (see Pagination). A key only sees invoices of its own mode. Filters combine: an invoice is listed when it matches all of them. Use `order_id` to find the invoice of one of your orders.

Requires an API key with the `invoices:read` scope.

post.description:
Creates an invoice in the key's mode and returns it with its `pay_url`, the link to send the customer to. The invoice starts `pending`, with no coin, amount or address: the customer picks a coin on the checkout, which locks the price for 20 minutes.

Requires an API key with the `invoices:write` scope.

Requires an API key with the `invoices:read` scope.

get.description:
What the key's company holds in the key's mode, one row per coin (every coin is listed, also at zero), with the same figures as the dashboard. Coin amounts are decimal strings with the coin's full precision. Dollar values use the last recorded price; `rates_stale` is `true` when a price is older than 10 minutes or missing. A coin's dollar values are `null` only when it has no recorded price, and the totals are `null` when a coin with a balance has none.

Requires an API key with the `balances:read` scope.

post.description:
Accepts the money held on an invoice that is `paid_late`, or `partially_paid` with its payment window ended. The money is credited to your balance (less the Hash fee) and the invoice becomes `paid` (`invoice.paid`, with `details.decision`). Any other status is `409 invalid_state`.

Requires an API key with the `invoices:decide` scope.

post.description:
Cancels a `pending` invoice on which no money of a known coin has arrived (`invoice.cancelled`). Once a payment is detected or received it is `409 payment_in_progress`; any other status is `409 invalid_state`. Money that still arrives on a cancelled invoice is always handled as late (`invoice.paid_late` or `invoice.partially_paid`). The request takes no body.

Requires an API key with the `invoices:decide` scope.

Credits the confirmed money held on a `wrong_network` invoice (paid on another chain or in another token of a known coin) to your balance, less the Hash fee. The invoice becomes `paid` (`invoice.paid`, with `details.decision`). Money of an unknown token cannot be credited (`409 asset_unknown`), and money not yet confirmed waits (`409 payment_not_confirmed`).

Requires an API key with the `funds:review` scope.

Adds a URL that receives signed events of the key's mode. The answer is the only time the signing secret (`whsec_...`) is ever shown: a retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` answers `409 secret_shown_once` with the endpoint but without the secret. Live URLs must be `https` and resolve to a public address; a sandbox key may also use `http://localhost` in local development. The URL is checked again before every delivery.

Requires an API key with the `webhooks:write` scope.

patch.description:
Changes an endpoint's URL, its events, or both, with the same checks as creating one (a new URL must be `https` with a public address; a sandbox key may use `http://localhost` in local development). The signing secret does not change and is never returned: rotate it in the dashboard. Deliveries not sent yet go to the new URL. Use it to move an endpoint (a new tunnel URL, a new server) without creating another.

Requires an API key with the `webhooks:write` scope.

post.description:
Turns a disabled endpoint back on: its failure count is reset and its pending deliveries are sent again now. On an endpoint that is already enabled it changes nothing and returns the endpoint. Hash disables an endpoint after 25 failed attempts in a row with no success for 72 hours. The request takes no body.

Requires an API key with the `webhooks:write` scope.

post.description:
Sends one signed `webhook.test` event (see the `webhooks` section) to this endpoint, whatever events it subscribes to, through the normal delivery path: it is retried like any delivery and shows in the deliveries list. The answer is the new delivery, `pending`. Use it to check your signature verification. The endpoint must be enabled (`409 endpoint_disabled`). At most 10 a minute per endpoint (`429 rate_limited`), within the key's 120. The request takes no body.

Requires an API key with the `webhooks:write` scope.

post.description:
An invoice was created (through the API or the dashboard). `data.invoice.status` is `pending`.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.created`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
A payment to the invoice address was seen on the network and is not confirmed yet. `details.payments` lists the transfer.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.detected`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
A payment to the invoice address is gathering confirmations. `details.payments` lists the transfer with its current confirmation count.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.confirming`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The invoice is paid in full (or within your underpayment tolerance) with confirmed money. This is the event to fulfil an order on. `details` carries the payments, the fee split (`fee_amount`, `merchant_amount`) and flags such as `overpaid`, `late` or `underpaid_within_tolerance`. It is also sent when you accept a late or short payment, or credit wrong-network money (`details.decision`).

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.paid`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
Confirmed money covers only part of the invoice. While the payment window is open the customer can still pay the rest. Once `details.window_ended` is `true`, the money is held for you: accept it (`POST /invoices/{id}/accept`) or refund it from the dashboard.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.partially_paid`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The price lock ended with no payment, or with a payment that never confirmed in time.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.expired`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The full amount arrived after the invoice expired or after it was cancelled. The money is held: accept it (`POST /invoices/{id}/accept`, the invoice becomes `paid`) or refund it from the dashboard.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.paid_late`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
Money for the invoice arrived on another chain or in another token. It is held. Credit it with `POST /invoices/{id}/credit-wrong-network` or refund it from the dashboard.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.wrong_network`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
A refund confirmed on chain and the invoice is now refunded in full. `details.refund` describes the refund.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.refunded`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
A refund confirmed on chain that does not refund the invoice in full. The invoice status does not change. `details.refund.refunded` is the total refunded so far.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.partially_refunded`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The invoice was cancelled, by you (`POST /invoices/{id}/cancel` or the dashboard) or by the customer on the checkout before picking a coin.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.cancelled`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
More money arrived on an invoice that was already closed (for example a second transfer after it was paid). The invoice status does not change. `details.extra` describes the transfer.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.extra_payment`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
A payment the invoice counted was undone by a chain reorganisation or dropped from the network. `details.reversed_tx` is its transaction hash. The invoice falls back to the status that the remaining money supports.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.payment_reversed`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
A transfer to the invoice address on another chain or in another token was recorded, or confirmed. The invoice status does not change. `details.wrong_network_payment` describes it; `held` is `true` once it is confirmed and held for your decision.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `invoice.wrong_network_payment`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
A withdrawal or refund was requested from the dashboard.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `withdrawal.requested`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The withdrawal waits for its approvers' passkeys. A refund also sends this once its destination is usable, and a withdrawal once its money reached the hot wallet.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `withdrawal.awaiting_approval`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The withdrawal has every approval it needs and is being signed.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `withdrawal.approved`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The withdrawal is reserved, and its money is moving from your deposit addresses to the hot wallet before it can be sent.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `withdrawal.funding`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The withdrawal is approved but the hot wallet cannot fund it. An owner pays it from the cold wallet, or it is signed again once a cold refill confirms.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `withdrawal.awaiting_cold`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The signed transaction was sent to the network. `tx_hash` is set.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `withdrawal.broadcast`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The transaction confirmed on chain. `fee` and `confirmed_at` are set.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `withdrawal.confirmed`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The withdrawal failed (the signer refused it, the transaction failed, or it can never confirm). `failure_reason` says why. The reserved money returns to your balance.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `withdrawal.failed`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
The withdrawal was cancelled before it was signed.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `withdrawal.cancelled`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
A chain reorganisation undid the confirmation of the withdrawal's transaction. It is back to `broadcast` and is watched again.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `withdrawal.reorged`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
Money sent straight to one of your wallet deposit addresses (not to an invoice) confirmed and was credited to your available balance. No Hash fee is taken.

Sent as a signed `POST` to every enabled endpoint of the event's mode that subscribes to `wallet.deposit_confirmed`. Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

post.description:
Sent only when you ask for it (`POST /webhook-endpoints/{id}/test`), to that one endpoint. It is not an event you can subscribe to and nothing else sends it. Nothing happened to any invoice, withdrawal or wallet: use it to check that your endpoint verifies the signature and answers 2xx.

Answer with any 2xx status within 10 seconds; anything else is retried for up to 72 hours.

test.message: A test event from Hash. Nothing happened to any invoice, withdrawal or wallet.

2XX.description: Received. Any other answer (or none within 10 seconds) is retried.

secretKey.description: A secret API key: `hash_live_sk_` (live) or `hash_sandbox_sk_` (sandbox) followed by 40 letters and digits. It decides the mode of everything the request touches.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes the request safe to retry: the same key with the same method, path and body answers with the first answer. 1 to 255 bytes, not blank. Kept for 24 hours, per API key and mode.

HashSignature.name: Hash-Signature
HashSignature.description: `t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the endpoint secret>`. During the 24 hours after a secret rotation a second `v1`, made with the previous secret, follows. Accept the request when any `v1` matches.

HashTimestamp.name: Hash-Timestamp
HashTimestamp.description: The same unix timestamp as `t` in `Hash-Signature`.

HashDeliveryId.name: Hash-Delivery-Id
HashDeliveryId.description: The delivery (`whd_...`): the same on every retry of this delivery, new on a resend. Pass it to `POST /webhook-deliveries/{id}/resend`. Deduplicate on the event `id`, not on this.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: How many objects to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, as given: it is opaque. Leave it out for the first page. Send the same filters with every page. A cursor this list did not hand out (or one that was changed) is `422 invalid_cursor`.

CreatedGte.name: created[gte]
CreatedGte.description: Only objects created at or after this time (inclusive). ISO 8601: a date (`2026-11-20`, from the start of that day, UTC) or a date-time with seconds and a zone (`2026-11-20T10:00:00Z`; URL-encode a `+` offset as `%2B`).

CreatedLte.name: created[lte]
CreatedLte.description: Only objects created at or before this time (inclusive). ISO 8601: a date (`2026-11-20`, up to the end of that day, UTC) or a date-time with seconds and a zone (`2026-11-20T23:59:59Z`; URL-encode a `+` offset as `%2B`).

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time when requests are allowed again.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present (`true`) when the answer is a replay of an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

MethodNotAllowed.description: The path exists but not with this method (for example `POST /balances`). Not listed under each operation: any method an operation does not document answers this.

message.description: A human-readable explanation. Do not parse it.

example.message: The POST method is not allowed here. Allowed: GET, HEAD.

Asset.description: A coin: `btc` (Bitcoin), `eth` (Ether), `bnb` (BNB on BNB Smart Chain), `usdt_trc20` (USDT on Tron), `usdt_bep20` (USDT on BNB Smart Chain), `trx` (Tron's own coin) or `sol` (Solana's own coin).

UsdAmount.description: US dollars as a decimal string with exactly 2 decimals, for example `"48.50"`.

CoinAmount.description: A coin amount as a decimal string with the coin's full precision, trailing zeros included: 8 decimals for BTC, 18 for ETH, BNB and USDT-BEP20, 6 for USDT-TRC20 and TRX, 9 for SOL. Compare as decimals, never as floats.

InvoiceStatus.description: `pending`: waiting for payment. `detected`: a payment was seen, unconfirmed. `confirming`: a payment is gathering confirmations. `paid`: paid in full (or within tolerance). `partially_paid`: confirmed money covers part of it. `expired`: the price lock ended unpaid. `paid_late`: the full amount arrived after expiry or a cancel, held for your decision. `wrong_network`: money arrived on another chain or token, held for your decision. `refunded`: refunded in full. `cancelled`: cancelled before any payment.

Metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs, returned to you and never shown to the customer. A flat object of at most 50 keys (each 1 to 40 characters) whose values are strings of at most 500 characters, numbers or booleans, at most 8 KB once encoded. Key order is not kept.

InvoicePayment.description: One transfer recorded on the invoice (any coin, any status).

tx_hash.description: The transaction hash (a base58 signature on Solana: case-sensitive).

output_index.description: The output (Bitcoin) or transfer position in the transaction. Unique together with `tx_hash`.

asset.description: `null` for a token Hash does not accept.

amount.description: The amount in the coin, full precision. For a token Hash does not accept (`asset` null) it is the raw integer amount in the token's smallest unit.

amount_usd.description: The amount in US dollars at the invoice's quote rate. `null` for another coin than the invoice's.

status.description: `seen`: not confirmed yet. `confirmed`: confirmed. `reversed`: undone by a reorganisation or dropped.

block_time.description: The timestamp of the block it was mined in, when known.

late.description: Paid after the invoice expired (by its block time), or after the invoice was cancelled.

Invoice.description: An invoice. New fields may be added; parse by name and ignore fields you do not know.

id.description: The invoice id.

number.description: Your company's invoice number: its prefix and a sequence, for example `NW-20042`.

order_id.description: Your order reference, unique per mode.

service_fee_usd.description: The service fee added on top when the customer pays it (`fee_payer` `customer`), else `null`.

total_usd.description: What the customer pays in US dollars: `price_usd` plus `service_fee_usd` when the customer pays the fee.

fee_payer.description: `merchant`: the fee comes out of what you receive. `customer`: it is added to the total.

allowed_assets.description: The coins this invoice may be paid in.

asset.description: The coin the customer picked, or `null` before they pick one.

amount.description: The amount of `asset` to pay, locked at `quoted_at`. `null` before a coin is picked.

address.description: Where the customer pays. `null` before a coin is picked.

paid_amount.description: Confirmed money of `asset` counted toward the invoice. `null` before a coin is picked.

expires_at.description: When the price lock ends (20 minutes after the quote).

callback_url.description: Deprecated and ignored: always `null` for new invoices. Use webhook endpoints.

success_url.description: Where the checkout sends the customer after a completed payment.

cancel_url.description: Where the checkout sends the customer after they cancel.

customer_email.description: The customer's email address, for the receipt.

description.description: Plain text shown to the customer.

pay_url.description: The checkout link to send the customer to: `https://pay.hash.bh/i/{id}`.

rate_usd.description: The quote rate (US dollars per 1 unit of `asset`) the amount was computed from, as received from the price source. `null` before a quote.

paid_usd.description: `paid_amount` in US dollars at the quote rate. `null` until money is counted.

overpaid_amount.description: How much more than `amount` was paid (`0` when not overpaid). `null` until money is counted.

underpaid_amount.description: How much less than `amount` was paid (`0` when not underpaid). `null` until money is counted.

hash_fee_amount.description: The Hash fee taken in `asset`. `null` until money is credited to your balance.

net_amount.description: What was credited to your balance in `asset`. `null` until money is credited.

net_usd.description: `net_usd + hash_fee_usd == paid_usd` whenever what was credited is what was paid.

payments.description: Every transfer recorded on the invoice, oldest first.

InvoiceList.description: A page of invoices, newest first (by creation time, then id). Follow `next_cursor` for the next page.

next_cursor.description: Send it as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

price_usd.description: The price in US dollars as a decimal string (never a JSON number): up to 10 integer digits and 2 decimals, more than zero.

order_id.description: Your order reference. Unique per mode: a second invoice with the same one is `409 duplicate_order_id`.

allowed_assets.description: The coins the checkout offers. Leave it out to offer every coin your company accepts. Only coins turned on in Settings, Payments may be named; another is a 422 naming the coin.

fee_payer.description: Who pays the service fee. Leave it out (or `null`) to use your company's setting.

callback_url.description: Deprecated and ignored (never stored). Still validated as an http(s) URL so older integrations keep working.

success_url.description: An absolute `https` link (or `http://localhost` on any port for sandbox keys). Hash adds `hash_invoice` and `hash_status=paid` to it.

cancel_url.description: An absolute `https` link (or `http://localhost` on any port for sandbox keys).

description.description: Plain text shown to the customer, up to 500 characters after cleaning: control and bidi characters are removed (line breaks kept) and the text is trimmed; an empty result is `null`. HTML tags are refused.

metadata.description: Your own data (see `Metadata`). `null`, `{}` and `[]` all mean none. A JSON integer outside the 64-bit range is refused: send it as a string.

note.description: A note kept in your audit log. It is not sent in webhooks.

expected.description: Optional. The preview of the amounts you confirmed. When it no longer matches what the decision would move, nothing moves and the answer is `409 preview_stale` with the current preview. Leave it out to decide on the current amounts.

Optional. The preview of the amounts you confirmed. When it no longer matches what the decision would move, nothing moves and the answer is `409 preview_stale` with the current preview. Leave it out to decide on the current amounts.

Balance.description: What the company holds of one coin, by bucket. `total` is the sum of every bucket.

usd_rate.description: The last recorded price in US dollars per 1 unit, or `null` when there is none.

available_usd.description: `available` in US dollars, rounded down to cents. `null` without a price.

total_usd.description: `total` in US dollars, rounded down to cents. `null` without a price.

balances.description: One row per coin, every coin listed.

available_usd.description: The sum of every coin's `available_usd`, or `null` when a coin with a balance has no price.

total_usd.description: The sum of every coin's `total_usd`, or `null` when a coin with a balance has no price.

rates_stale.description: `true` when a coin's price is missing or older than 10 minutes.

WebhookEventType.description: An event you can subscribe to. See the `webhooks` section for each payload.

url.description: Where events are sent. `https` with a public address (no credentials in it). A sandbox key may use `http://localhost` in local development only.

events.description: The events to send to it.

url.description: Where events are sent. `https` with a public address (no credentials in it). A sandbox key may use `http://localhost` in local development only.

events.description: The events to send to it, replacing the current list.

UpdateWebhookEndpointRequest.description: What to change: send `url`, `events` or both. What you leave out stays as it is.

WebhookEndpoint.description: A URL receiving signed events of one mode. Never includes the signing secret.

enabled.description: `false` once Hash (or you, from the dashboard) disabled it. Deliveries for a disabled endpoint wait (pending) until it is enabled, for up to 72 hours.

WebhookEndpointWithSecret.description: A new endpoint, with its signing secret. This is the only time the secret is shown.

enabled.description: `false` once Hash (or you, from the dashboard) disabled it. Deliveries for a disabled endpoint wait (pending) until it is enabled, for up to 72 hours.

secret.description: The signing secret for `Hash-Signature`. Store it now: it is never shown again.

WebhookEndpointList.description: A page of webhook endpoints, newest first (by creation time, then id). Follow `next_cursor` for the next page.

next_cursor.description: Send it as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

WebhookDelivery.description: One delivery of an event to an endpoint: the first send and its retries (60 s, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h, 12 h, then every 12 h, for up to 72 hours). A 2xx answer within 10 seconds counts as delivered.

event_id.description: The event id, the same on every delivery and resend of the event.

response_status.description: The HTTP status of the latest attempt, `null` before one (or when no answer came).

WebhookDeliveryList.description: A page of webhook deliveries, newest first (by creation time, then id). Follow `next_cursor` for the next page.

next_cursor.description: Send it as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

ValidationError.description: A request that failed validation. `errors` maps each field (for example `allowed_assets.1` or `metadata.cart_id`) to its messages. This answer has no `error` code.

message.description: The first message, with a count of the others.

ErrorCode.description:
Every `error` code the merchant API returns:

- `invalid_api_key`: The bearer token is missing, malformed, unknown, revoked or expired.
- `insufficient_scope`: The key is valid but lacks the scope this operation needs. `required` names it.
- `tenant_suspended`: The company is suspended. Its keys may still read, but every write is refused.
- `company_not_ready`: The company was requested from the dashboard and Hash has not approved it yet.
- `rate_limited`: Too many requests. Wait `retryAfter` seconds (also in the `Retry-After` header).
- `idempotency_key_required`: The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing, blank or longer than 255 bytes.
- `idempotency_key_in_progress`: This request waited 5 seconds for an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key` and the same body, and that request was still running, or it ended while this one waited with an answer that is not kept (a 5xx, 408, 409, 423, 425 or 429). Nothing was stored for the key: retry with the same key. A finished earlier request is then replayed; one that failed runs again. A request that never answered frees its key after 60 seconds.
- `idempotency_key_reused`: The `Idempotency-Key` was already used for a different request (another method, path or body, or the other mode).
- `idempotency_key_unreadable`: The stored answer for this `Idempotency-Key` can no longer be read. The request already ran once and is never run again: look the result up instead.
- `secret_shown_once`: This request already succeeded and its answer showed a secret, which is never shown twice. `resource` is what was created, without the secret.
- `not_found`: No such object in this key's company and mode.
- `method_not_allowed`: The path exists but not with this HTTP method (`405`). The `Allow` header lists the methods it accepts.
- `invalid_cursor`: The `cursor` is not one this list handed out, or it was changed. Start again from the first page.
- `duplicate_order_id`: An invoice with this `order_id` already exists in this mode. `invoice_id` is that invoice.
- `mode_not_ready`: The company has no wallet on this mode's network yet, so it cannot receive payments in this mode.
- `payment_in_progress`: A payment is being processed (or was received), so the invoice can no longer be cancelled.
- `invalid_state`: The decision does not apply to the invoice in its current status.
- `refund_in_progress`: A refund of this invoice is still in progress.
- `asset_unknown`: The held wrong-network money is of a token Hash does not know, so it cannot be credited.
- `payment_not_confirmed`: The held wrong-network money is not confirmed yet.
- `preview_stale`: The amounts in `expected` no longer match what the decision would move. `preview` holds the current amounts.
- `endpoint_disabled`: The delivery's webhook endpoint is disabled. Enable it first.
- `php_jit_enabled`: Hash is temporarily unavailable (`503`), an operational problem on Hash's side that its operators are alerted to. Nothing was done: retry later, with the same `Idempotency-Key` for a `POST` or `PATCH`.

Error.description: The error envelope: a machine-readable `error` code, sometimes a `message`, and fields specific to the code (`required`, `retryAfter`, `invoice_id`, `preview`, `resource`). Each operation lists the codes it can return.

held.description: `true` once it is confirmed and held for your decision.

decision.description: When the event follows a decision.

actor_type.description: Who decided: an API key, a dashboard user, Hash itself (for example the customer's cancel at checkout) or Hash support.
